headline: ZHA 3D-prints voluptuous chair from recycled plastic
context: Architecture studio ZHA, formerly Zaha Hadid Architects, has worked with Spanish brand Nagami to launch the 3D-printed Echo Chair made from recycled plastic. The sculptural chair, envisioned using parametric design software, features an arching backrest that extends to the ground

sources.name: Dezeen
sources.summary: Architecture studio ZHA, formerly Zaha Hadid Architects, has worked with Spanish brand Nagami to launch the 3D-printed Echo Chair made from recycled plastic. The sculptural chair, envisioned using parametric design software, features an arching backrest that extends to the ground in one plane and a seat that scoops up at the sides to hug the sitter. The post ZHA 3D-prints voluptuous chair from recycled plastic appeared first on Dezeen .
